Name: Approve vs pay expenses
Risk: One person could approve a claim and release the payment for it, enabling fraudulent claims.

Name: Deploy to production vs bypass code review
Risk: One person could disable branch protection, merge unreviewed code and deploy it to production.

Name: Change HR records vs administer identities
Risk: One person could create a fictitious employee in HR and then control their account: a "ghost employee".

Name: Administer the tenant vs control the audit trail
Risk: A tenant administrator who can also delete logs could act and then erase the evidence.

Name: Administer Salesforce vs sell
Risk: An admin who also sells could change opportunity, quota or commission data in their own favour.

Name: Change HR records vs run payroll
Risk: One person could add an employee and pay them.
